title: Morning: the 30 is finished in draft, the 70 is two-thirds written
headline: Four hours at the hourly pace. The 30-page edition is cleared, traced and pictured, 28 pages. The margin clock is on the pages, counting clock hours (my call, CK1, yours to overturn). Chapter 2's chain map and chapter 5's 'Your factory' map are in. The 70-page edition has gone from nothing to twelve chapters, parts 1 to 4, 38 pages so far, and parts 1 to 3 have been read by security, the researcher, the librarian and the historian; part 4, written at 04:34, has so far had only the storyteller's read. The developer has put both drafts online with each scene's record linked under it. Both PDFs are attached. Two things still need you: what to print and how, and the Sonnet move.

sections.title: The night, hour by hour
items: 01:00 to 02:00: your notes went to every member; one head per run fixed; the cleared screenshots placed; the 30 cleared end to end.
02:00 to 03:00: the margin clock planned (hour one to hour nineteen) and its stats registered (C108, C110); the 70 outlined in full; the 30 corrected on the historian's eighteen findings.
03:00 to 04:00: the clock placed on clock hours; chapter 2's map and chapter 5's team cards in; RC2 online with each scene's record (the developer: 33 scenes, 253 links).

04:00 to 05:00: the 70's part 3 checked (security, researcher, librarian, historian all clear) and part 4 written (the storyteller's read so far); every picture the 70 names for ruv-sgit drawn and placed.

In the open: security caught that one screenshot in the 70 shows a sentence the record contradicts ('By 17:40 the editor had agreed all ten'; the record says 8 of 10); the writer and the publisher are masking it. Security also logged its own slip (a pre-review it wrote itself) as evidence for the book.
